summary.short: Commission decisions designating named companies (Alphabet, Amazon, Apple, ByteDance, Meta, Microsoft, later Booking) as gatekeepers and designating their core platform services under the Digital Markets Act (DMA). First designations on 6 September 2023; additions in 2024 and one undesignation in 2025.
summary.long: This portal page records European Commission decisions under the Digital Markets Act (DMA) that designate gatekeepers and their core platform services. On 6 September 2023 the Commission designated Alphabet, Amazon, Apple, ByteDance, Meta and Microsoft as gatekeepers. On 29 April 2024 Apple was designated for iPadOS, and on 13 May 2024 Booking was designated as a gatekeeper for its online intermediation service Booking.com. On 23 April 2025 Meta was undesignated for its online intermediation service Facebook Marketplace. For each company the page lists its designated core platform services with case numbers, 23 in total, including search, video, app stores, operating systems, browsers, online advertising, social networking, messaging, marketplaces and a PC operating system. Each company entry links to its designation decision, which the page does not reproduce. The page also points to resources on submissions, the designation process, and information on acquisitions under Article 14 of the DMA.[The page describes its scope as designations made to date; it does not state the operative provisions of the decisions themselves.]

notes: The document is the Commission's web summary of gatekeeper designations, not the designation decisions themselves (linked as 'Download the Designation Decision' but not reproduced). Registry metadata gives the regulation number and Article 3, which the body does not state. The introduction's count of 23 core platform services matches the listed services. Case numbers are printed as shown and are shared: DMA.100011 (Google Maps, Google Shopping), DMA.100020 (Facebook, Instagram), DMA.100024 (WhatsApp, Messenger). The introduction also records that Meta was undesignated for Facebook Marketplace on 23 April 2025; this is not coded as an event and is not in the Meta list. The Apple iPadOS designation (29 April 2024) and Booking designation (13 May 2024) are dated only in the introduction. No LEI or ticker is verified.
